about_the_game:
■ Action Game Focused on Melee Combat

Dawn of Kemet is a 2D action game with an ancient Egyptian theme. Immerse yourself in rhythmic melee combat, utilizing weapons like swords, shields, and lances, with more than five other cold weapons planned.

―――Shield blocking, parrying, guarding, lance stepping, and more...

You can switch weapons during battle, and each weapon comes with its own set of actions, allowing you to develop your own combat style.

■ Bosses with Unique Characteristics and Charms

―――The Executioner of the Underworld, the Dancer of Rest… Defeat the various gods with unique personalities and charms using your strength.

These ruthless bosses will challenge you with overwhelming power. Attack and accumulate damage to bring them into a groggy state for a more powerful strike. Depending on the boss, you may witness phase transitions, part destruction, and changes in appearance.

■ Boss Rush Mode

The bosses here feature challenging difficulty levels. Avoid, counter, and dismantle their relentless patterns in your own style, and defeat the gods.

We've streamlined the exploration process leading to each boss, offering a boss rush format with consecutive battles. Face the trials without pause and rise to the challenge.

Clearing bosses allows you to craft new equipment. With enhanced strength, take the fate of Kemet into your own hands.

Good luck.
